body.name: supplied rational interval representation of design inputs
body.construction:
A supplied rational interval name for the design inputs is a nested sequence
\[
 \mathfrak r(m)=\prod_j[r_j^-(m),r_j^+(m)],\qquad m\in\mathbb N,
\]
with rational endpoints, containing \((p,c_M,c_I,\alpha,G)\), having maximum coordinate width at most \(2^{-m}\), preserving positive lower bounds for the rate and cost coordinates, and certifying \(0<\alpha<1\) and \(G\geq0\).  This definition specifies input data supplied to the certification theorem; it does not assert an implementation that constructs the name from arbitrary real inputs.
